# Pearl Public School District

> > Pearl Public School District (PPSD) serves students in Pearl, MS with comprehensive K-12 education, athletics programs, and parent resources across multiple campuses.

The district operates Pearl High School, Pearl Junior High School, Pearl Upper Elementary, Pearl Lower Elementary, and Northside Elementary, providing educational technology platforms including Clever, Google Classroom, Accelerated Reader, and ActiveParent for student and family engagement.

## Key Topics

- Pearl Public School District (PPSD)
- Pearl High School
- Pearl Junior High School (PJHS)
- Clever
- Google Classroom

- Accelerated Reader

- Vaccination requirements
